messages:
jamie: AM standup — quick pipeline snapshot:
- Acropolis: LOI back, legal reviewing (expected EOW) — needs BYOK KMS confirmation from @samir
- NimbusHealth pilot: Dedicated infra request; SE support queued
- MicroBank: POC demo Wed 9am PT — need stable endpoint + canary model

teri: Got it. For Nimbus, I spun up a staging VPC (nimbus-stg-3). @eva pushed the demo prompt set to the repo. Can someone confirm HSM vs KMS requirement?

samir: quick Q: is customer asking for customer-managed HSM or just KMS keywrap? If HSM, need HSM onboarding checklist (PCI scope) — will add to ticket #SEC-412

eva: MicroBank demo — can we pin model to rwd-3.1-quant? latency matters. @jamie can you confirm acceptable 99th p99 latency? they asked <120ms

jamie: p99 <=120ms is target, but we can accept 150ms if cost savings >20% for demo. I'll follow up with customer. @teri can you enable `latency_mode: low-p99` in demo config?

teri: will do. config snippet I pushed:
``
model: rwd-3.1-quant
runtime:
  latency_mode: low-p99
  cache: enabled
```

deploy-bot: demo-env (microbank-demo) created — endpoint: https://staging.redwood.io/microbank-demo (token masked)

samir: FYI — for Acropolis LOI, I need contract clause confirming key control. Send legal contact to me or link to the doc. Also flagged possible IP policy in SEC-412.

jamie: TNK. I'll DM legal and paste link here when available.

eva: quick ask — any code review pending for demo prompts? I left comments in PR #478. @teri @jamie please review today if possible.

teri: acked, will do after lunch. Should be minor.

jamie: blocker: waiting on legal + samir for BYOK wording. otherwise green. Today: follow up legal, prep MicroBank slides, coordinate demo runbook.

samir: blocker for me: need customer KMS spec + legal confirmation. I can approve HSM path after that. ETA: EOD if docs arrive.

eva: I'm free for a dry run 4pm PT. Drop a calendar invite and I'll join.

jamie: scheduled 16:00 PT — invite sent. thanks :thumbsup:
